scenarios.name: Valid card saved successfully — returns 200 with non-null token
scenarios.description: A verified customer with a valid Bearer token POSTs a complete, new Visa card with a future expiry. The system fingerprints, deduplicates, tokenises via vault, persists, and returns a reusable token.

step_descriptions.action: Ensure vault-service mock returns token 'tok_test_abc123' for card 4111111111111111
POST /payment/v1/cards with complete valid CardDto for customer CX-001
step_descriptions.curl_reference: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/payment/v1/cards -H 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"cardNumber":"4111111111111111","expiryMonth":12,"expiryYear":2028,"cvv":"123","holderName":"Test User"}'
step_descriptions.expected_result: HTTP 200 with body {"token": "tok_test_abc123"} — token is non-null string

step_descriptions.action: Verify one row inserted in payment_cards with customer_id=CX-001
step_descriptions.expected_result: Exactly one row in payment_cards table for CX-001

preconditions: Customer CX-001 exists with valid Bearer token
Card 4111111111111111 (Visa, Luhn-valid) not previously saved for CX-001
Vault-service mock configured to return 'tok_test_abc123'
Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled = ON

step_descriptions.action: POST /payment/v1/cards with expiryYear=2024 (past year)

scenarios.name: Duplicate card for same customer returns 409 DUPLICATE_CARD
scenarios.description: Customer CX-001 has already saved card 4111111111111111. A second identical save attempt returns 409.

step_descriptions.action: Confirm fixture: payment_cards row for (customer_id=CX-001, fingerprint=SHA256('CX-001:4111111111111111')) already exists
POST /payment/v1/cards with the same card details for CX-001
Verify no new row inserted in payment_cards

preconditions: Customer CX-001 has card fingerprint SHA256('CX-001:4111111111111111') already persisted in payment_cards
Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled = ON

scenarios.name: Vault service returns 503 — API returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with no DB row written
scenarios.description: Vault-service mock returns 503. No row must be written to payment_cards; API returns 503.

step_descriptions.action: Configure vault-service mock to return HTTP 503 for all tokenise requests
POST /payment/v1/cards with a complete valid CardDto
Query payment_cards for customer_id=CX-001
step_descriptions.expected_result: Zero rows — no partial DB state written

preconditions: Valid customer CX-001 with Bearer token; new card not previously saved
Vault-service mock configured to return 503
Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled = ON

scenarios.name: Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled=OFF returns 404 without processing payload
scenarios.description: When the feature flag is disabled, the endpoint returns 404 immediately. No validation, no DB access, no vault call.

step_descriptions.action: Set feature flag payment.card_save.enabled to OFF in test environment
POST /payment/v1/cards with any valid or invalid payload
step_descriptions.expected_result: HTTP 404 — no validation error, no vault call, no DB write

preconditions: Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled set to OFF
Vault mock not needed — should never be called

scenarios.name: Concurrent duplicate save race condition — exactly one succeeds with 200, other returns 409
scenarios.description: Two identical requests for the same customer+card arrive simultaneously. DB unique constraint is the final guard; exactly one request succeeds and the other receives 409.

step_descriptions.action: Launch two concurrent POST /payment/v1/cards requests for customer CX-001 with the same card 4111111111111111, in parallel threads
step_descriptions.expected_result: Both requests complete. Response set: {200, 409} — exactly one 200 and one 409 DUPLICATE_CARD

step_descriptions.action: Query payment_cards for customer_id=CX-001
step_descriptions.expected_result: Exactly one row in payment_cards — no duplicate row

preconditions: Customer CX-001 with valid Bearer token; card 4111111111111111 not previously saved
Vault-service mock returns token on first successful call
Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled = ON
Test harness capable of launching parallel HTTP requests

scenarios.name: Raw cardNumber and cvv values never appear in application logs at any log level
scenarios.description: PCI-DSS compliance scenario. On both successful and failed requests, no cardNumber or cvv plaintext must appear in logs at DEBUG, INFO, WARN, or ERROR levels.

step_descriptions.action: Attach in-memory log appender capturing all log levels (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR)
POST /payment/v1/cards with a complete valid CardDto (cardNumber=4111111111111111, cvv=123)
Search captured log output for string '4111111111111111' and '123'
step_descriptions.expected_result: Neither '4111111111111111' nor '123' appear in any log line at any level

step_descriptions.action: POST /payment/v1/cards with an invalid card to trigger error path (missing expiryMonth), then search logs again
step_descriptions.expected_result: HTTP 400 returned. No card data in logs even on error path

preconditions: Application deployed with all log levels enabled (logback test config at DEBUG)
In-memory log appender or log capture mechanism available
Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled = ON

step_descriptions.expected_result: HTTP 200 — validation accepts 13-digit card; response includes non-null token

Vault-service mock returning test token

scenarios.name: Maximum-length 19-digit card number is accepted

step_descriptions.action: POST /payment/v1/cards with a 19-digit Luhn-valid card number (e.g. 6703444444444444449)

scenarios.name: Card expiring in current month and year is valid and accepted
scenarios.description: Boundary test: expiryYear=currentYear and expiryMonth=currentMonth (August 2026) — card is NOT in the past. RFC specifies this as valid.

step_descriptions.action: POST /payment/v1/cards with expiryYear=2026 and expiryMonth=8 (current month)
step_descriptions.expected_result: HTTP 200 — expiry check passes; card is accepted (not INVALID_EXPIRY)

preconditions: System clock: August 2026
Vault-service mock returning test token

scenarios.name: Vault call timeout after 5000ms returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with no DB row written
scenarios.description: Vault-service mock delays response beyond 5000ms timeout. Exactly one retry is attempted (RFC: 1 retry). After retry also times out, API returns 503 and no row is persisted.

step_descriptions.action: Configure vault-service mock to delay response by 6000ms (exceeds 5000ms timeout) for all tokenise requests
step_descriptions.expected_result: Vault mock ready with timeout behaviour

step_descriptions.action: POST /payment/v1/cards with complete valid CardDto
step_descriptions.expected_result: HTTP 503 with body {"error": "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE"} — returned after 1 retry (~10s total vault wait)

step_descriptions.action: Query payment_cards for customer_id=CX-001
step_descriptions.expected_result: Zero rows — no DB write on vault timeout

step_descriptions.action: Verify vault call count in mock
step_descriptions.expected_result: Exactly 2 vault calls recorded (1 original + 1 retry)

preconditions: Valid customer CX-001; card not previously saved
Vault-service mock configured with 6000ms delay
Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled = ON

Query pg_indexes for payment_cards

scenarios.name: Card number failing Luhn algorithm returns 400 MISSING_FIELD
scenarios.description: Card number has correct length (16 digits) but fails Luhn check. RFC step-3 maps this to 400 MISSING_FIELD (reuses same error envelope).

step_descriptions.action: POST /payment/v1/cards with cardNumber=1234567890123456 (fails Luhn check)
step_descriptions.expected_result: HTTP 400 with body {"error": "MISSING_FIELD", "field": "cardNumber"} — Luhn failure uses MISSING_FIELD envelope per RFC

preconditions: CardValidationService with Luhn check enabled

Calculate p95 latency from response time distribution
